question: With the enactment of Government of India Act, 1919 the provincial budget was _________
solution:
The correct answer is separated from the __**Central budget.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• By the **Government of India act 1919,** the provincial budget is **separated from the Central budget.**
 
• The government of India act of 1919 authorized the **provincial legislature to enact its budgets.**
 
• The Government of India act 1919 further divided the** provincial subjects into two parts- transferred and reserved.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Government of India Act 1833

 
• The trading rights of the company were completely abolished by this act.
 
• Now the task of the Company was to govern India on behalf of the British Government.
 
• The Governor General of Bengal came to be known as the Governor General of India.
 
• The fourth member was inducted as Law Member in the Governor General's Council.

 Government of India Act 1853

 
• Through this act, the principle of nomination in the services was abolished and arrangements were made to fill the important posts of the company on the basis of competitive examinations.
 
• For this Lord Macaulay Committee was appointed in 1854.
